text:
alex: FYI seeing a weird routing oscillation this morning in eu-west after the tenant-affinity tweak. requests bounce between regional pools every ~30s.
maya: ugh, saw that too. looks like our region probe timestamps are being treated as equal after the change so tie-breaker flips.
jordan: can you paste the trace? is it the probe TTL or the EWMA window?
alex: trace: routing-decisions -> probe-score delta shows alternating small diffs, then hedged fallback triggers. no obvious errors in runtime.
sam: my hunch: probe sampling is too coarse and combined with our affinity weight smoothing it creates a band where small noise flips priority. same as a thermostat oscillation.
maya: agree. options: increase probe frequency, add hysteresis, or widen EWMA half-life. all have tradeoffs (cost, latency, slower failover, memory).
katie: how invasive is adding per-route hysteresis vs. doing a global EWMA param tweak? we need minimal policy-dsl churn for the rollout.
jordan: per-route hysteresis gives better control but touches policy surface. global EWMA param is cheap but may hurt real failovers (longer detection).
alex: probe cost is non-trivial in cross-region probes. we can't double probes for every tenant. maybe adaptive probe rate: more probes when signal variance high.
probe-bot: suggestion: add variance-driven probe throttle. if variance(metric) > threshold -> increase probe rate for affected region for N seconds.
sam: nice. implement as: compute short-window variance sigma2 over last M samples, then rate = clamp(base * (1 + k * sigma2), base, max).
maya: can we do that without changing DSL? infra layer only? sounds like runtime tuning which is fine.
katie: still need an escape hatch in policy DSL to pin region preference for 1 tenant (enterprise). maybe optional annotation: "region_stability_hint": "pin|prefer|auto". string default auto.
jordan: good compromise. runtime adaptive probes + optional policy hint for enterprise pinning.
alex: also need to avoid exacerbating oscillation with hedging. if a hedged request falls back and writes telemetry that triggers a probe, we get feedback loop.
sam: add a probe-origin tag and ignore telemetry generated by hedged fallbacks for variance calc. simple filter: if request.origin == "hedge" then drop from variance window.
maya: ops concern: changing variance calc might change metrics dashboards. we should add new metrics: probe_rate_by_region, variance_window_size, skipped_hedge_count.
infra-bot: rolling out probe adapter 2/x to canary cluster now (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-probe-adp). expect 2m for health checks.
alex: rollout plan proposal: 1) runtime-only change: adaptive-probe adapter behind feature flag. 2) enable for staging for 24h, run sim harness to ensure no oscillations. 3) enable canary 1% traffic, validate latency SLOs. 4) expose optional DSL hint in next minor release.
katie: need a docs blurb for the DSL hint and suggested values + fallback semantics. i'll draft.
jordan: one more: we should set a hard lower bound on probe interval to avoid thundering herd on region recoveries. e.g., min_interval = 5s.
sam: and cap EWMA half-life min to preserve failover time: half-life >= 5s. add tests.
maya: test matrix: variance regimes (low/high), hedged traffic percentage (0/5/20%), enterprise pinned routes, region flapping emulation.
alex: ok action items: @maya proto adaptive probe adapter + tests, @sam update variance calc filter + metrics, @katie docs + DSL hint PR, @jordan add hard lower bounds + canary playbook. i'll own feature-flag rollout.
katie: tagging stakeholders: @platform-owners, @sre for canary watch, @security for no changes to control plane.
alex: thanks. if we all agree i'll open RFC follow-up with config snippets and a minimal policy DSL annex.
maya: thumbs up :thumbsup:
jordan: +1
probe-bot: noted. scheduled simulation job: sim-probe-flap-2026-03 (ETA 3h).
infra-bot: canary up. health: ok. logs: "probe-adapter: started; feature_flag=adaptive_probe"
alex: sweet. we'll monitor.
